chunk_map.heading: The post-it was the craft on a budget

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: reader cannot resolve a pronoun. Closest: L8 'It was what the craft shrank to' - 'It' = 'the post-it' in the preceding sentence of the same chunk; L4 'you were right to want it' - 'it' = the outcome-driven work named in the same sentence. Both resolve in-chunk.
Harm: callback by file position. No pointer to another file or earlier lecture anywhere in L4-8 (only the wall/post-it scene).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw/caught' backward reference in L4-8

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no live-demo or guess-before-reveal beat; static framing slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: slide says nothing standalone. L4-8 carry a full claim: craft was right, testing cost a sprint, post-it was rationing. Closest: L8 one-line paragraph, but it sits under L4-6 and states the thesis.

Harm: header contradicted by body. Header 'The post-it was the craft on a budget' vs L8 'It was what the craft shrank to when building was expensive' and L6 'A real test of one idea cost a sprint' - body supports header literally (budget = scarce tests).

Harm: visible LLM tic on a dense slide. Closest: L8 'The post-it was not naive. It was what...' is one negation plus one assertion, not Not X. Not Y. Z.; L4 three fragments ('An outcome on the wall. The opportunities under it... A few ideas...') are three different concrete objects, not anaphora. No superlative, no number+retraction ('a few a year' is attested framing in the maintainer Guard), no empty verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: maintainer dialect on a wall. Body vocabulary: outcome, opportunities, post-it, sprint, craft, building - all ordinary product-team words. 'beat'/'mood'/'surface'/'firing' absent from L4-8.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body.txt -> 0; no bold on slide, within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read
rules_evaluated.na_reason: single slide file with its own slide marker; composition into the deck is the training index's, and no phase-less section lives in this file
